verified_facts.text: The Whitley is a luxury hotel in Buckhead, Atlanta.
verified_facts.excerpt: is a luxury hotel in Buckhead, Atlanta, ideally located in the vibrant Buckhead community

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near Phipps Plaza.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience ultimate relaxation at our hotel near Phipps Plaza.

verified_facts.text: A dedicated floor holds the spa, with a lounge, boutique, treatment rooms and a Himalayan salt room.
verified_facts.excerpt: dedicated floor featuring a spa, lounge, boutique, treatment rooms and a newly added Himalayan salt room

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments include facials, body scrubs, salon services, manicures and pedicures.
verified_facts.excerpt: where indulgences include facials and body scrubs, salon services, manicures and pedicures, among others

verified_facts.text: The indoor heated pool has a glass roof that lets in natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy swimming a few laps in our indoor heated pool with a glass roof, allowing plenty of natural light in.

verified_facts.text: Spa guests can relax in the lounge, an indoor saline pool and a whirlpool.
verified_facts.excerpt: we encourage you to plan extra time to relax in our lounge, indoor saline pool, and whirlpool

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have high ceilings and a featherbed with Egyptian cotton sheets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step inside a luxury hotel room or suite with high ceilings, delicate décor and a featherbed with 400-thread-count Egyptian cotton sheets.

verified_facts.text: The suites use Egyptian cotton linens by Frette.
verified_facts.excerpt: Settle into our hotel suites in Buckhead, GA with 400-thread-count Egyptian cotton linens by Frette

verified_facts.text: Rooms have large bay windows with panoramic views of Buckhead.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soak up panoramic views of Buckhead from your newly renovated hotel room with large bay windows

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have two mirrors, Italian marble countertops and a tiled shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your spacious bathroom offering two mirrors, Italian marble countertops and a tiled shower

verified_facts.text: The Whitley Suite has sweeping views of Atlanta and Buckhead.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Whitley Suite is a graceful 1,800 square feet of space with sweeping views of Atlanta and Buckhead.

verified_facts.text: The Whitley Suite has a dining room with a butler's pantry and an entertainment area with a billiards table.
verified_facts.excerpt: It boasts a dining room with butler’s pantry as well as an entertainment area with a billiards table.

verified_facts.text: Trade Root Restaurant & Lounge serves Southern fine dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: Trade Root Restaurant & Lounge explores the subtlety and finesse of Southern fine dining.

verified_facts.text: Trade Root's ingredients are sourced from local suppliers in Buckhead.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our ingredients are fresh, flavorful and sourced from local suppliers in Buckhead.

verified_facts.text: Daniel Alicea is the executive chef.
verified_facts.excerpt: Follow Executive Chef Daniel Alicea on a culinary journey.

verified_facts.text: The decor pairs jade greens with creams and dark woods.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expensive jade greens meet creams and dark woods to comprise a satisfying limited palette

verified_facts.text: Rocking chairs in the living room recall a wraparound porch.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits near the upscale department stores and indie art galleries around Miami Circle and Bennett Street.
